name: 3-Piece Enamel Cooking Pot Set
description: A classic 3-piece enamel cooking pot set (2L, 3.5L, 5L) built for gas and charcoal jikos alike. Chip-resistant coating, even heat distribution, and the deep cobalt finish found in kitchens across East Africa.
shortDescription: Durable 3-piece enamel pot set for everyday cooking.

name: Non-Stick Frying Pan, 28cm
description: A 28cm non-stick frying pan with a reinforced coating that holds up to daily use on gas stoves. Stay-cool handle and a flat base built for even heat.

name: 24-Piece Stainless Steel Cutlery Set
description: A 24-piece stainless steel cutlery set: 6 spoons, 6 forks, 6 tea spoons, 6 knives. Rust-resistant and dishwasher-safe, in a reusable storage tray.
shortDescription: Complete cutlery set for a family of six.

name: Unbreakable Plate Set (6 Pieces)
description: Six food-grade, shatterproof plates in assorted colours. Lightweight, stackable, and ideal for busy households or outdoor gatherings.

name: Airtight Glass Storage Jar Set (5 Pieces)
description: Five airtight glass jars in graduated sizes, with rubber-sealed clip lids — ideal for flour, rice, sugar, tea, and spices. Keeps pantry staples fresh and pest-free.
shortDescription: Airtight glass jars for pantry staples.

name: 6-Piece Kitchen Knife Set with Block
description: Six kitchen knives (chef, bread, utility, paring, and two steak knives) with a wooden storage block. Carbon-steel blades that hold an edge through daily use.
shortDescription: Full knife set with wooden block.
